name: ecuador-social-contributions
description: Ecuador social security contributions (IESS) for 2026 for people who pay their own: the self-employed (trabajadores autónomos), professionals in private practice, business owners and legal representatives, voluntary affiliates resident in Ecuador and Ecuadorians abroad, unpaid home workers, pensioners and the Seguro Social Campesino. Covers who must be affiliated (Ley de Seguridad Social art. 2), the self-declared materia gravada with its floor of one salario básico unificado (USD 482 for 2026), the 20.60% total rate for independent and voluntary affiliates (IESS Resolución C.D. 501), the 0.10% disability levy, the 13.25% home-work scale with state subsidy, payment within 15 days after the month, automatic exit after 30 days unpaid, mora interest and how employee and employer rates link to payroll.
